title: activation ledger: a switch write that names a package binds the first of two package-less rows, hiding the duplicate
body:
domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named site and a reproduction. Found beside #32094 by its card thread (os-dev report 6765651104, PR #32172 "Acceptance notes"); same defect class, a different producer, not fixed there.
Business reason: an operator upgrading to 18.4 with two package-less switch rows for one item must see the duplicate until they delete the wrong row. #32094 makes the boot backfill report it instead of binding one. A single enable/disable click through a door still binds the first row and hides the pair, so the switch that applies is again picked by storage order.
Reader: the next `domain:server` seat that claims it; the fix is a door decision in `@objectstack/core`'s store and its callers.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `setActive package-less` (4 hits: #32094 open, its sibling at the backfill; #31682 and #12159 closed; a seat post), `activation ledger duplicate package` (115 hits, none on point: #32094 is the backfill, #32164 the permission-set doors).
reach: a door write. Reading on core dist at PR #32172's head `2a278698`, real SQLite, after one door write on an item with two package-less rows: `[{"id":"d1","package_id":"com.example.app183","active":0},{"id":"d2","package_id":null,"active":1}]`; on the next boot the package-less index builds over the pair.

## What happens

`ObjectStoreMetadataActivationStore.setActive` (`packages/core/src/utils/metadata-activation-store.ts`) called with a `packageId`, on an item whose ledger holds two rows naming no package, updates the first match and writes its `package_id`. One row then names the package and one does not, so the package-less unique index no longer refuses, and the duplicate is never reported again. With #32094's backfill, the boot reports the item at `error` on every boot, but the index stays built.

Producers that call it with a package: the flow enable/disable door (`service-automation` `flow-definitions.ts`, `setActive` with the loader's package), the action door and the catalog activation door.

## Expected

A switch write never binds one of two package-less rows for an item. The door answers with a refusal that names both rows and the operator's remedy (delete the row that should not apply), the same stance #32094 takes at boot. Which answer the doors give (status and code) is decided at step 0 against the existing ADR-0150 two-holder answers.

Grade suggestion: p1, same upgrade path as #32094.
